Your store might look stunning, but your backend data is likely silent. If your product photos are tagged with useless filenames like`IMG_4402_red.jpg`—or worse, nothing at all—you are actively hurting your growth.

Here is why this "invisible anchor" drags down your sales:

### Google Is Blind to Your Images

Search engines cannot "see" your high-resolution photography. They rely entirely on alt text to understand context and index your products.

### You Are Alienating Shoppers

In an inclusive economy, accessibility is non-negotiable. Missing descriptions block visually impaired users from understanding your products.

### Legal Risk Exposure

Poor accessibility invites scrutiny regarding ADA and WCAG compliance. The average settlement runs $10,000-$50,000.

The AltText.ai Shopify App automatically generates optimized alt text for your product and store images. The app is Certified Built for Shopify, meaning it does not slow down your store and has been rigorously tested by Shopify to meet their speed and quality standards.

### From your Shopify Admin

- Go to Apps, and type `AltText.ai` in the search bar at the top of the popup window.
- Click the AltText.ai listing, then click the Install button on the app page.

### From the Shopify App Store

- Visit the AltText.ai listing on the Shopify App Store, or just search for `AltText.ai` in the app store.
- Click on the AltText.ai listing, then click Install to add it to your store.
